quote: In short, we found partial support for the replication hypothesis 2.
reason: Although the abstract broadly states that Experiments 1A and 2 to 4 were replicated, the Results and Discussion explicitly report only partial support for Hypothesis 2 (Experiment 2), as emotion ratings did not differ from moral wrongness judgments in the intentional and failed-attempt conditions and knowledge ratings showed a larger difference than moral wrongness in failed attempts.

quote: We found partial support for the replication hypothesis 3.
reason: While the replication reproduced the significant ANOVA interactions from Experiment 3 (p. 41), the authors explicitly conclude that Hypothesis 3 received only partial support because disgust differences exceeded moral wrongness differences only in the accidental condition and, contrary to the original study, the domain-by-intent pattern was not specific to moral judgments versus disgust ratings (pp. 38, 44, 47).

Table 5 (p. 21) reports the Experiment 4 replication effect size (d = 0.32, 95% CI [0.21, 0.43]) without a p-value column, but Table 9 (p. 30) and the text on p. 41 explicitly report p < .001 (t(329) = 5.80) for this exact test.
